newsitem.title: USA: Edmund Jenkins to become FASB chairman July 1.
newsitem.headline: Edmund Jenkins to become FASB chairman July 1.

text.p: The Financial Accounting Foundation said on Tuesday that it had named Edmund Jenkins to a five-year term as chairman of the Financial Accounting Standards Board.
Jenkins, who recently retired as managing partner of the Professional Standards Group of Arthur Andersen LLP, will begin his term on July 1.
Jenkins was a charter member of the FASB's Emerging Issues Task Force, serving from the task force's inception in 1984 to 1991, the Financial Accounting Foundation said in a statement.
Jenkins is the fourth chairman in the FASB's 24-year history and replaces Dennis Beresford, who will retire on June 30 after serving the maximum two five-year terms.
The Financial Accounting Foundation funds, oversees and appoints the members of the FASB and the Governmental Accounting Standards Board.
